lines.differs: Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: rates for change orders and future SOWs are locked for 36 months.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: no interest is charged on late payments, unlike the 12% per annum rate previously.
Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: invoices are payable within 30 days instead of 45 days.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: client owns the deliverables upon payment, whereas the supplier retained ownership of all work product.
Same as Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: client owns deliverables upon payment while AtliQ retains its pre-existing tools.
Same as Crestline Retail Inc: client owns deliverables upon payment while AtliQ retains its pre-existing tools.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: liability cap excludes confidentiality breaches and indemnities, exposing AtliQ to uncapped liability.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: liability cap excludes confidentiality breaches and indemnities rather than only fraud and wilful misconduct.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: liability cap excludes indemnities, exposing AtliQ to uncapped liability for third-party claims.
Same as Acme Retail Group: mutual indemnity for third-party claims arising from IP infringement, confidentiality breaches, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
Same as Sunrise Foods: mutual indemnity for third-party claims arising from IP infringement, confidentiality breaches, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: client provides mutual indemnity for confidentiality and gross negligence, rather than indemnifying solely for IP infringement.
Same as Acme Retail Group: liquidated damages are 0.5% of the milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: liquidated damages are 0.5% per week capped at 5% of milestone fee, instead of 1% per day uncapped.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: liquidated damages are 0.5% per week capped at 5%, compared to 1% per week without a cap.
